# Diagnosis session snapshots

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's session-state saver for the dbskill ecosystem: turn a diagnosis conversation into a structured markdown snapshot (YAML frontmatter + conclusions, rejected directions, open hypotheses, next skill) filed per project under a configurable archive root (`~/.dbs/`, project-local `.dbs/`, or custom) — making repeated diagnoses cumulative instead of cold-starting every time. Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; written for Chinese-speaking users; snapshots are unencrypted local plain text — don't file secrets; only meaningful inside the dbskill toolchain.
